text:
marta: Quick sync — targeting Private/VPC on-prem release 1.4.8 next Tue 03:00 UTC. Packaging includes: delta installer (shrinkwrap), OCI images with layer dedupe, and cosign key rotation. Need deploybot window, KMS freeze/handoff, and clear rollback pins. Ops available?

devops-bot: deploybot tentative window recorded for Tue 2026-03-24 03:00 UTC. Runbook: RB-2026-148. Canary stage and full rollout jobs created (will post job-ids after confirm). Reply :thumbsup: to lock window.

kevin: Ops team available. Quick Q: what are the exact manifest / checksum expectations? We should verify TTLs on the offline manifest store (some customers pin TTL to 7d).

sana: Packaging note: shrinkwrap completed, but one image uses zstd:v1.5 compression; older on-prem installers (<=1.4.6) don't support it. I'm building a fall-back image compressed with gzip and tagging as v1.4.8-compat.

leo: Suggest rollout plan: 1) canary to 5 customers for 30m 2) expand to 25% for 60m 3) full at 2h if no regressions. Also pin fallback manifest to v1.4.7-legacy so deploybot can revert instantly.

anthony: Rollback rules: if cosign verification fails on >1 host or deploybot reports >5% startup failures in canary, abort and revert to pinned manifest. We need cosign TTL and a secondary verification path using KMS-signed attestations. Confirm key access to Ops.

marta: Added a short preflight checklist, please ack: 
- confirm cosign signatures for all images
- verify manifest checksums in offline store
- test installer apply on a 2-node airgapped cluster
- freeze KMS rotation 24h before window
- set deploybot canary & rollback pins

Example cosign verify command (used in CI):
```
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/prod/keys/cosign-key \
  ghcr.io/redwood/installer:v1.4.8-shrinkwrap
```

ops-runner: Acknowledged. KMS key KMS-PRD-02 rotation currently scheduled 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC — we will pause rotation and mark key as stable from 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC until 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC. I'll also run an access smoke test against a QA KMS replica.

devops-bot: deploybot note: canary job created job-id: db-job-4312-canary. Will post status in this thread and #deploy-notifications. I will auto-abort if cosign verification fails or if health-check rate >5% in any host group.

marta: Perfect. I'll update release notes, docs, and the SRE runbook with the canary windows and rollback pins. @kevin please confirm offline manifest TTL check by EOD today. If no objections, I'll lock the window in 2h.

kevin: Roger. Will run TTL/checksum sweep and post results in this thread by 18:00 UTC.
